relationship_candidate.note: This assessment applies only to the 22,483-assertion candidate identified by the hashes and semantic roots in this file. A rebuilt candidate requires a separately named audit.

reviewer.independence: The reviewer did not edit the generator, rules, schemas, source corpus or generated enrichment data. A second read-only Codex subagent performed a separately seeded actual-corpus semantic scan.
limitations: Independent analytical assurance, not third-party or qualified UK legal-practitioner assurance.
The 139 known false positives are a lower bound derived from clear title-level contradictions; the audit does not claim exhaustive legal classification.
Exact reviewer and rule-authoring model deployment identifiers and billable Codex task usage are not exposed.
The candidate enrichment files were uncommitted when assessed; hashes, counts, the assertion-ID-set hash and chunk-root hash bind this decision.

intended_use.dataset: Non-official candidate discovery-topic relationships for UK legislation works
intended_use.assertion_grain: One source-work, target-topic and predicate assertion
intended_use.release_question: Did the second remediation produce a candidate suitable for promotion as independently reviewed discovery metadata?

scope.ordered_manifest_chunk_root_algorithm: SHA-256 over each manifest chunk in order as UTF-8 path, NUL, sha256, NUL, bytes, NUL, records, LF
scope.sorted_assertion_id_set_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted assertion IDs, one UTF-8 ID per line with a final LF

commands.result: Codex enrichment synchronized: 365,786 attempts, 22,483 accepted assertions, $0 API cost
Full-corpus independent reconstruction, integrity, contract, metadata, calibration, collision and deterministic-sampling audit
Concurrent authored/generated Whole-Law integration has frontmatter and publication-time errors; no enrichment assertion error was reported
Whole-Law integrity path set does not equal publication path set
bundle/checksums.json is missing or out of date

full_corpus: Read all 366 source chunks and all 365,786 source works.
Recompiled every include and exclude regular expression independently.
Reconstructed the exact post-exclusion, existing-topic-suppression and same-topic-suppression assertion sequence for every chunk.
Recomputed source and output hashes, byte counts, record counts, semantic input digest and attempt-ledger values.
Compared each reconstructed assertion object and ordered chunk sequence to the generated data.
Validated all 22,483 assertions directly against the synchronized OKF Explorer relationship-assertion.v2 schema.
Validated the run record against model-enrichment-run.v1.
Checked assertion identifiers, duplicates, source and topic referential integrity, literal evidence, authority, derivation, review, verification, rights and freshness.
calibration: Independently replayed 55 unique positive and 55 near-miss negative rule tests.
Recomputed precision, recall, evidence support, false positives and false negatives and compared them to the generated calibration.

primary_sample.topic_selection: Five assertions per emitted topic by ascending SHA-256(topic label + NUL + source identifier)
primary_sample.rule_selection: Three assertions per emitting rule by ascending SHA-256(rule identifier + NUL + source identifier), or every assertion when a rule emitted fewer than three

secondary_independent_sample.selection: Separately seeded SHA-256 ranking over assertion IDs, five per topic and three per emitting rule, with the sole R039 assertion reviewed exhaustively
secondary_independent_sample.result: No clear false positive in the seeded sample; all known failures were found by adversarial whole-output scans

checks.evidence: Every source and output chunk, count, hash, attempt and reconstructed assertion reconciled.
Local and OKF Explorer relationship-assertion.v2 schemas had identical SHA-256; all 22,483 assertions validated.
Every target used canonical topic/<slug> form and joined a published topic.
55/55 positives, 55/55 near-miss negatives and 40/40 end-to-end cases passed, but the authored cases omit the actual-corpus collision families found in this audit.
All 147 European Social Fund include hits were excluded; none remained among 194 emitted R041 assertions.
No police-station, prisoner-defence, defence-certificate, criminal, crime or prosecution title remained among 1,184 emitted Civil assertions.
At least 139 clear false positives remained across R008, R010, R033 and R034; R033 and R010 fell below 95% precision on known errors.
Assertions remained explicitly model-assisted, non-official discovery metadata, pending independent review, OGL-bound and freshness-dated.
No-match and excluded-without-rerouting records remain visible as recall limitations and are not fabricated as assertions.
The complete Whole-Law publication and checksum validators failed on concurrent integration state; the enrichment-specific checks did not fail mechanically.

findings.title: R033 maps animal-only and veterinary medicines to Health and social care
findings.what_failed: The undifferentiated medicines pattern emits 123 clear veterinary, animal-use or animal-feed records into Health and social care. The count conservatively excludes titles saying Products Other Than Veterinary Drugs and mixed human-and-veterinary EU measures.

examples.title: The Medicines (Products for Animal Use—Fees) Regulations 2004
The Medicines (Medicated Animal Feeding Stuffs) (Amendment) Regulations 1997

findings.why_it_matters: R033's known precision ceiling is 82.7%, and these records contribute almost one tenth of the Health topic output. The rule set itself places animal health under Environment, energy and agriculture, so the outputs are internally inconsistent.
remediation: Exclude veterinary, animal-use and animal-feed contexts from the Health medicines rule.
Route supported animal-only medicines titles to Environment, energy and agriculture or a governed veterinary-medicine concept.
Add actual veterinary-medicine and Products Other Than Veterinary Drugs contrast cases as hard negatives and positives.
Require at least 95% precision for each emitting rule and material topic slice, not only the aggregate calibration.

findings.title: R008 inherits Legal Aid from a parent Act name when the instrument's subject is criminal
findings.what_failed: Eleven instruments match Legal Aid only because the phrase is part of the parent title Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012. Their specific subjects are alcohol-monitoring sentence requirements, criminal fines or youth detention.

examples.title: The Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 (Alcohol Abstinence and Monitoring Requirements) Piloting Order 2017
The Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 (Fines on Summary Conviction) Regulations 2015
The Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 (Children Act 1989) (Children Remanded to Youth Detention Accommodation) Regulations 2012

findings.why_it_matters: A phrase in a parent Act name is not evidence that a child instrument regulates that phrase's domain. This collision pattern can recur wherever multi-subject parent legislation is cited.
remediation: Distinguish parent-instrument citation text from the child instrument's specific subject phrase.
Conservatively exclude the known criminal-subject suffixes or require a second Legal Aid occurrence in the child subject.
Add each distinct collision family to rule-level and end-to-end hard-negative tests.

findings.title: R010 matches civil as a prefix of Civilian
findings.what_failed: The civil alternation in the R010 pattern has no ending boundary. It therefore emits all three Magistrates' Courts (Civilian ... Enforcement Officers) titles as Civil justice and procedure.
findings.why_it_matters: This is a deterministic regex defect and leaves R010 below the 95% precision threshold.
remediation: Require a word boundary or complete civil subject token after the alternation.
Add Civilian Enforcement Officers as a rule-level hard negative.

findings.title: R034 maps Animals (Cruel Poisons) legislation to Health and social care
findings.what_failed: Two explicit animal-cruelty titles match the generic poisons token and emit Health and social care.
findings.why_it_matters: The subject is animal welfare rather than human health or social care; the generic token hides a small but clear polysemy collision.
remediation: Exclude the Animals (Cruel Poisons) family from R034.
Route it to a governed animal-welfare/environment concept if supported.
Add the actual titles as hard negatives.

findings.title: Model-authoring provenance remains partial
findings.what_failed: The run prompt_hash is a digest of a synthetic prompt basis assembled by the generator, not the exact Codex rule-authoring transcript. Exact model deployment, exposed parameters and task usage remain unavailable in the run record.
findings.why_it_matters: Deterministic rule execution is reproducible, but the model-assisted rule-authoring step is not fully reproducible from the run manifest.
remediation: Name the field prompt_basis_hash or link it to a hash-bound governance transcript.
Record exact hashes or explicit unavailable reasons for the authoring transcript, model identity, parameters and schema.

findings.title: Run metrics mix assertion and record grains
findings.what_failed: accepted_assertions is assertion-grain while rejected_records is record-grain. The provider manifest separately identifies 22,443 records with accepted assertions.
remediation: Group record and assertion metrics explicitly.

findings.title: Nine calibrated rules emit no assertion in this snapshot
findings.what_failed: R002, R007, R014, R017, R024, R036, R042, R045 and R047 emit no assertion after matching and suppression; R007 has no corpus include match.
findings.why_it_matters: This does not damage emitted data, but synthetic rule-test coverage must not be presented as actual-corpus output coverage.
remediation: Publish raw include, excluded, suppressed and emitted counts per rule.
Treat no-output rules as dormant or aliases until a corpus hit exists.

required_before_new_audit: Remove or reroute the 123 veterinary and animal-only R033 Health assertions.
Remove or reroute the 11 R008 parent-Act criminal-subject Civil assertions.
Correct the R010 civil-prefix match and remove its three Civilian Enforcement Officers assertions.
Remove or reroute the two Animals (Cruel Poisons) Health assertions.
Add actual-corpus hard negatives and rule/topic-slice precision gates for every corrected collision.
Rebuild to new hashes and rerun full independent reconstruction and fresh actual-corpus sampling.
